name: Tougou Chiharu
source:
Akito's younger cousin. To most people she appears as a cheerful and innocent kid, but when she's alone with Akito she reveals that she is sexually sadistic and dominant. She dominates Akito whether he likes it or not.

[spoiler]She does have a softer side, shown when Akito gives her a bracelet and she becomes gentle and emotional.[/spoiler]
